independent_audit: 2026-11-12, Codex gpt-6.1-sol (high) on a separate machine, with its own programs and no access to the repository code or to earlier audits, read the public source of commit 45c917f line by line. Verdict SOUND for both theorems: the uniform lower bound for the three-state chain (holding-time domination, the margin exp(-2) f(eps) on [0,2]), the limiting gamma-quantile argument (first crossing controlled by uniform convergence and a strictly negative derivative) and the optional stopping proof (Dynkin martingale at U ^ t, bounded and dominated convergence, no independence of U and X_U needed). Its own computations: tau_0, tau_1 and dbar(2) at eps = 0.01 and 0.001 to 36 places in 85-digit arithmetic, matching every printed prefix (tau_1 = 2.13306..., ratio 1.06663..., 1.07244..., dbar(2) = 0.40240..., ratio 1.0421... at eps = 0.05); t_k for k <= 60 certified by rational brackets of width 1e-40; the stopping inequality on random reversible chains in continuous and discrete time with 2,500 full linear programs, no violation, the optimum also realized by an explicit randomized stopping rule. Requested wording changes, all made in public_commit e311262: the sentence on Hermon's theorem now states the quantity (largest expected hitting time of a set of stationary mass at least 1/2 from the stationary law conditioned on its complement, Hermon Theorem 1.1, resolving Aldous-Fill Open Problem 4.38; checked against arXiv:2304.05878v1) since the unconditioned reading is false on a two-state chain; the holding rate at state 0 is stated; tau_0(P) and tau_1(P) are written out in the discrete-time paragraph; the case of infinite E_i U is disposed of explicitly; the computer-check paragraph is split; 'no external data'; bibliography label width; revision date.
